purpose: Keep Cyberpunk-version-sensitive bindings in explicit thin boundary adapters so project-original simulation models remain as patch-resilient as practical.
rules: A production REDscript file containing a native hook annotation must be listed in allowedHookFiles.
Core simulation/model files must not contain native hook annotations.
Adding a new native seam requires updating this manifest with an intentional reviewable change.
A game patch should normally be repaired at these seams before changing stable simulation models.
This contract localizes patch-sensitive code; it does not claim any listed seam is guaranteed stable across CDPR patches.
